name: io.github.cunicopia-dev/knowledge-graph-rdbms
title: Knowledge Graph RDBMS
description: A label property graph on SQLite/Postgres with multi-ontology routing and a gated MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: KGRDBMS_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Storage root for ontology databases and the event log. Defaults to ~/.kgrdbms.

environmentVariables.name: KGRDBMS_DEFAULT_ONTOLOGY
environmentVariables.description: Name of the default ontology used when a tool call omits the `ontology` argument. Defaults to "default".
